Parents Die in Maharashtra While Trying to Save Son After iPhone Dispute

In Sambhajinagar, Maharashtra, a teenage boy reportedly jumped off a hill after being denied a new iPhone. His parents subsequently died while attempting to rescue him. The incident occurred due to a dispute over the mobile phone.
